items.escena: A rounded green clay start flag planted on a small hill at the beginning of a winding clay path
A black and white checkered clay finish flag at the end of a winding clay path
A clay hand dropping a round clay token into the slot of a friendly little clay machine
Seven clay marbles being split into two equal rows of three, with one single marble left over on its own
A clay diamond-shaped road sign at a fork in a clay path, one road going left and one road going right
Clay marbles arranged in perfect pairs, two by two, with no marble left over, a green light glowing above
Clay marbles arranged in pairs with one single lonely marble left at the end, an orange light glowing above

items.texto: Secuencial: las instrucciones se ejecutan una tras otra.
items.escena: A straight row of clay dominoes falling one after another in order

items.texto: Condicional: toma un camino según una condición («si… entonces…»).
items.escena: A clay path splitting into two roads at a signpost, a tiny clay figure standing at the fork deciding

items.texto: Repetitiva: repite acciones mientras se cumpla una condición.
items.escena: A small clay train running round and round a circular clay track

items.texto: Saludar, pedir el nombre y despedirse, en ese orden.
items.escena: Three small clay scenes in a row: a figure waving hello, the same figure holding out a blank name card, the same figure waving goodbye
A clay exam paper on a desk with a big green clay tick mark stamped on it and a little celebrating clay student

items.texto: Mientras queden mensajes sin leer, abrir el siguiente.
items.escena: A clay mailbox with a stack of envelopes, a clay hand opening them one after another, opened ones piling up on the side
